title: Console: add residency settings read/update endpoints + RBAC checks
author: Chloe Martin
description: Context: As part of Hosted Data Residency Enforcement, Console needs backend endpoints to display and modify an org/project’s residency configuration (pinned_region / allowed_regions) with least-privilege RBAC. This PR adds Console API endpoints (behind a feature flag) to read/update residency settings, enforces permission checks via RBAC, and includes basic integration tests to validate expected 200/403/400 behavior. Scope: 1) Endpoints: GET /console/api/v1/orgs/:orgId/residency-settings returns the effective residency policy for the org (and whether the feature is available for the org tier); PATCH /console/api/v1/orgs/:orgId/residency-settings updates pinned_region and/or allowed_regions (and validates mutual exclusivity / precedence per ADR-042). These endpoints call the control plane policy evaluator service to read/write canonical policy state rather than storing Console-local copies. 2) RBAC: Introduces permission gates residency.settings.read and residency.settings.write. Console RBAC middleware maps these permissions to roles via the policy bundle; unauthenticated/unauthorized callers receive 403 with standard Console error shape (code=FORBIDDEN, details include required_permission). 3) Validation / ergonomics: Validates region identifiers against the hosted region registry; rejects unsupported regions with 400 (code=INVALID_ARGUMENT) and a field-level error pointer. Normalizes empty arrays to null to reduce accidental misconfiguration. 4) Feature flag: Endpoints are disabled unless residency_console_settings_api is enabled (allows staged rollout prior to UI exposure). 5) Tests: Adds integration tests covering (a) compliance-admin can read/update (b) developer role can read only (c) random org member denied update (d) invalid region rejected (e) pinned_region + allowed_regions simultaneously rejected. Notes: This PR intentionally does not wire UI; that is handled in PR #18502. Also does not emit audit events for updates; those are emitted by the control plane policy service on successful writes (tracked in ENG-2844 / PR #18466).
commits: console/api: add ResidencySettingsController (GET/PATCH) for org-level settings
console/auth: add RBAC permission checks for residency settings routes
console/services: integrate with Policy Evaluator client for residency policy read/write
console/validation: region validation + pinned/allowed precedence validation
tests: add integration coverage for RBAC + validation
docs(internal): add endpoint notes + error examples for Support/CS
conversation: Felix Schneider (review): Can we clarify whether this endpoint returns the “effective” policy (after precedence) vs raw stored fields? UI will want to show what’s actually enforced. Chloe Martin (author): Good call — updated GET response to include both raw fields and effective_mode (PINNED | ALLOWED_LIST | NONE) computed via the shared policy validator so the UI can render a single source of truth. Marcus Lin (review): Please ensure we don’t allow updates for orgs without enterprise controls enabled; otherwise customers may think it’s active when it isn’t. Chloe Martin: Added feature gate + plan gate; PATCH returns 403 FORBIDDEN with reason=FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE if plan doesn’t include it. Brian Murphy (review): Error shape should include machine-readable details for field errors; also avoid region strings in logs at INFO. Chloe Martin: Updated validation errors to include field pointer (e.g. $.pinned_region) and lowered logs to DEBUG with redaction for request body. Benji Okafor (review): PATCH currently accepts allowed_regions=[]; that can be ambiguous (is it ‘deny all’?). Better normalize to null and reject empty. Chloe Martin: Implemented: empty array is rejected (400) and docs updated. Dylan Brooks (review): Can we keep route naming consistent with other settings endpoints? Prefer /residency-settings over /data-residency. Chloe Martin: Renamed routes and updated tests accordingly. Approvals: Felix Schneider approved; Marcus Lin approved; Brian Murphy approved; Dylan Brooks approved.
release_notes: Internal only: adds Console API endpoints (flagged) for reading/updating residency settings with RBAC checks; no customer-visible change until flag + UI are enabled.
